Welecome to Collecto!
Here are some tips to make using the app easier :)

 . You can activate the Post Voice assistant by double clicking on the post in the main page.
 -> You can remove a post from a collection by saying: remove from cpllection CollectionName
 -> You can add a post to a collection by saying: Add to collection CollectionName

 . You can activate the voice assistance for Collection operations too!
 -> In the Collection Page by clicking on the 'Collections' in te toolbar.
 You can create a new collection by saying: Create collection CollectionName
 You can delete a collection by saying: Delete collection CollectionName

 -> In the Single Collection Page by clicking on the collection name in the toolbar.
 You can rename the collection by saying: rename collection to newCollectionName
 You can delete the collection by saying: Delete (the) coleection

 Yeah that is easy right!
 But don't worry, you can do all the mentioned operations manually too!
